subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Escrever, em colaboração com os colegas e com a ajuda do professor, fotolegendas em notícias, manchetes e lides em notícias, álbum de fotos digital noticioso e notícias curtas para público infantil, digitais ou impressos, dentre outros gêneros do campo jornalístico, considerando a situação comunicativa e o tema/assunto do texto.

components.description_pt: Escrever colaborativamente uma legenda ou manchete adequada à situação comunicativa da notícia
components.description_en: Write collaboratively a photo caption or headline suited to a news story's communicative situation
components.cc_component_description: Organize informational or explanatory writing in a manner suited to purpose and audience

components.description_pt: Escrever colaborativamente um lide ou pequena notícia para público infantil
components.description_en: Write collaboratively a lede or short news article for a young audience
components.cc_component_description: Compose writing within short time frames for a specific task, purpose, or audience

components.description_pt: Produzir colaborativamente um álbum digital de fotos de notícia considerando tema e contexto comunicativo
components.description_en: Produce collaboratively a digital news photo album considering its topic and communicative context
components.cc_component_description: Use digital tools and the Internet to produce and publish written products

cc_matches.description: Produce clear and coherent writing in which the development, organization, and style are appropriate to task, purpose, and audience.

Write routinely over extended time frames (time for research, reflection, and revision) and shorter time frames (a single sitting or a day or two) for a range of discipline-specific tasks, purposes, and audiences.
Use technology, including the Internet, to produce, publish, and update individual or shared writing products in response to ongoing feedback, including new arguments or information.
